summary.zh: 设计 A/B 实验并分析数据与模型效果
summary.en: Design A/B tests, run causal analysis and evaluate models

description.zh: 设计与解读实验：A/B 测试的样本量和指标定义、因果推断、特征工程与模型评估。适合判断某个改动是否真的带来提升、该补哪些特征，或评估模型好坏时使用。
description.en: Designs experiments and reads the results: A/B test setup, sample size and metrics, causal inference, feature engineering and model evaluation. Use it to tell whether a change caused a lift or how good a model is.
